# Fixtures for `eml` (Email message)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. People, places,
companies and addresses (Saltmere, `example.org`, `*.example`) are fictitious.
`fee-reminder-signals.eml` carries phishing *signals* (mismatched Reply-To, display name and link
text, failed authentication) for the risk checks; it has no attachment and no payload.
